data.name: The Fusing Anthro-Pokémon Synthesizer
data.creator_notes:
Works well with both Claude and GPT-4. Claude can ignore the formatting from time-to-time.

Note that Generation 9 Pokemon aren't supported by any of the AI models, Generation 8 seems to be the limit and it's not 100% there. Works best with Gen 7 and below.

Prompts and JBs will also influence generations rather heavily. (IE: leaving NSFW prompts on tend to increase the likelihood of the Naughty nature being generated.)

You can also specify specific things to be generated, such as nature, size, etc. manually as well.

Art by Azuu!
